The '''Skryls''' were sharp-[[Tooth/Legends|toothed]] aquatic [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. They whelped on the ice during winter and basked on the island's shores in spring and summer.<ref name="Mountaintop Rescue" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Skryls appear in ''[[Mountaintop Rescue]]'', the adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beginner Game]]''.
